name: final-v1
notes: Frozen experimental decisions for the held-out evaluation (72 episodes, --dataset heldout --split test --final --repos configs/repos.heldout.json). MODEL: gemini-3.5-flash-lite through the Gemini OpenAI-compatible endpoint, one model for every condition (pinned here so a wrong .env cannot change it; API keys stay in .env). Retrieval: hybrid BM25 + Voyage voyage-code-3 (RRF), reranking off, warmed cache results/embedding_cache; the BM25-only comparison is the separate retrieval study (results/retrieval_heldout_*). Guard: UPDATE_TEST repairs need mutant-kill retention >= 0.90 against the mutants the PRE-repair tests killed (the developer's reference tests are evaluation-side only and never reach the Guard); strength no mutant can measure is UNMEASURABLE and escalates (never a pass, no invented score); structural checks (removed assertions, skip/xfail, loosened comparisons, swallowed exceptions, scope) always apply; one revision, then escalate. Patch rule: expected_value (the scope-restricted relaxed rule). The Guard and patch policy are not loosened to raise repair rates. Tool faults: seeded, 10% of agent tool calls (patch does not apply, invalid test selector, timeout) on top of each episode's own scenario-T plan; API/rate-limit errors are never injected faults. Scoring: PRIMARY direction macro-F1 = direction_from 'hypothesis' (the side the agent blamed for each test, UPDATE_TEST vs FIX_CODE only, an escalation takes the side its hypothesis names; this is the proposal's per-test direction prediction); SECONDARY direction macro-F1 = action-based (an escalation is undecided), always reported next to it. Final-action accuracy and macro-F1 (including ESCALATE), escalation rate and repair coverage are reported separately. A Guard escalation after a correct repair counts as a wrong final action (a correct repair needs correct direction, passing tests and preserved integrity). The hypothesis verdict uses the primary metric only and is reported as it comes out. Hypothesis thresholds: the Detailed Project Idea's values, CONFIRMED UNCHANGED after the dev pass (nine episodes cannot calibrate them; none is tuned). B2 is not part of the final matrix: the B2 comparison is reported as not evaluated. Run order: FULL, B1, A1, A2, A3 at seed 0, then FULL and B1 at seed 1; the held-out contamination probe runs first. Secrets never go here.
